note: Two valid projections of Parent (Good, and SpelledRange whose one-year range has Parent's bounds) and one table per projection rule; the refusal lists every offending table on its own line and leaves the valid ones alone. The shared cells never reach the one-to-one check: the projection rules refuse first.
fails_if: a projection naming a missing table or itself, a projection of a projection, a partitioned projection, a projection of a partitioned parent, a projection with another edition, or a projection mapping a variant its parent does not map stops being refused, or a valid projection is refused (including one whose edition is spelled differently with the same bounds)

message_contains: table['Orphan'] projection of 'Missing': names no other table of this inventory
table['Self'] projection of 'Self': names no other table of this inventory
table['Chain'] projection of 'Good': names a projection; name the table it projects
table['Sharded'] projection of 'Parent': a projection and its parent carry no partition
table['OfShard'] projection of 'ShardParent': a projection and its parent carry no partition
table['Later'] projection of 'Parent': a projection has its parent's edition and period scope
table['OtherVariant'] projection of 'Parent': maps variants its parent does not: scb/example/monthly
